Class Snapshot

Namespace
Tuinet.Testing
Assembly
Tuinet.dll

Snapshot tests for frames: Tuinet.Testing.Snapshot.Verify(Tuinet.CellBuffer,System.String,System.Boolean,System.String,System.String) compares a buffer with snapshots/<name>.txt next to the test's source file. On a mismatch (or a missing snapshot) it writes <name>.received.txt beside it and throws; set TUINET_ACCEPT_SNAPSHOTS=1 to write the snapshots instead, then review them in the diff.

var buffer = new CellBuffer(40, 10);
app.Render(buffer, nowMs: 0);
Snapshot.Verify(buffer, "main-screen");

Parse(string)

Read a styled snapshot (Tuinet.Testing.CellBufferTesting.ToStyledString(Tuinet.CellBuffer)) back into a buffer as wide as its widest line and one row per line. Plain text parses too, since it is markup without tags (escape [ as [[).

Verify(CellBuffer, string, bool, string?, string)

Compare buffer with snapshot name: as Tuinet.Testing.CellBufferTesting.ToStyledString(Tuinet.CellBuffer) when styled (colors and attributes count), else as plain text (Tuinet.CellBuffer.ToString). Trailing spaces and blank lines are ignored. Snapshots live in directory, by default a snapshots folder next to the calling test's source file.

public static void Verify(CellBuffer buffer, string name, bool styled = true, string? directory = null, string sourceFile = "")
